items.summary: Risk disposition: BLOCKED for SearchWoot public beta, full launch, alert expansion, affiliate use, and advertising. Woot documentation proves API access mechanics only; current public terms do not evidence rights to store, derive, cache, publicly display, alert on, or monetize the data. Keep private and preview-only. Human counsel is required for upstream data rights, jurisdictional privacy treatment, and future affiliate or advertising use. Rights outreach remains unsent pending counsel review and owner authorization.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active: 0 of 4 tasks closed and 4 open. Evidence progress is limited to official API/terms/support review, partial repository/configuration data-flow evidence, privacy and cookie-policy artifacts, and draft terms. Close no task without direct evidence. Next evidence action: attach one consolidated read-only bundle covering field-level rights, data flow, retention, deletion, correction, access, notification consent, unsubscribe behavior, GA4 settings, log fields, vendors, incident/request procedures, accuracy/freshness controls, and rollback evidence.

Fleet compliance disposition: ordinary reversible growth is CONDITIONAL and may continue only when it adds no credentials, permissions, dependencies, new data collection, or cross-site behavior and preserves consent, disclosures, provenance, claims, copyright/trademark, affiliate, platform-policy, and age-sensitive boundaries. Public exposure and security-sensitive releases remain BLOCKED where compliance, security, or launch evidence is missing. Compliance baseline is 37 pass, 16 fail, and 6 unknown of 59 checked sites; failures include banner, accept/reject controls, and GA4 checks. Do not infer certification.

Private-site decision: keep complicated.work, deadlymaracas.com, and driveford.net parked, private, preview-only, and unlaunched. Do not publish, deploy, alter DNS, configure analytics, monetize, spend, add dependencies, or create queue work. Next evidence action: attach a dated readiness packet for each covering ownership, preview/build, compliance, security, measurement boundary, rollback point, and explicit blockers.
